comparison.objective: Draft task packs products, closes carton flaps, peels tape from a loose roll, seals the carton, and cuts the strip; the candidate adjusts gripper hardware.
comparison.physical_skill: PR-2209 proposes product placement, flap folding, thin-film peeling/payout, adhesion, and cutting; the candidate uses rigid coaxial tools and countertorque.
comparison.success_condition: PR-2209 proposes containment, flap-order, connected-strip bond coverage, end wraps, parked tools, and a two-second release; the candidate checks angular locking and repeated motion.
comparison.reason: The draft's incomplete validation does not obscure that its tested manipulation and intended outcome are unrelated to stop adjustment.
